judgements.name: The required return — capitalise at the measured cost of capital, or hold du's own current EBITDA multiple into perpetuity
judgements.alternative: the other framing, computed and published beside it
judgements.why: the cash-flow lens is the central and the market-multiple terminal is published beside it at its own value, never averaged

judgements.name: Post-2029 fiscal regime — the extended 38%+9% construction, or reversion to the pre-2024 15%-of-revenue + 30%-of-profit one
judgements.alternative: the other framing, computed and published beside it
judgements.why: du disclosed the 2027-2029 extension itself on 24-Jul-2026; reversion after 2029 is a named tail, priced, not a coin-flip

judgements.name: Risk-free tenor — the Jan-2031 T-bond at 4.48%, or the Feb-2033 sukuk tap at 4.13%
judgements.alternative: the other framing, computed and published beside it
judgements.why: the most recent primary print on the longest liquid tenor; the sukuk is a different instrument type and its debut print is five months stale

judgements.name: Blended ARPU — held roughly flat, or eroding at the per-leg rate the postpaid-mix decomposition implies once the tailwind exhausts
judgements.alternative: the other framing, computed and published beside it
judgements.why: the disclosed path is flat-to-slightly-up; the erosion case is priced as the largest operating downside in the study rather than assumed away

judgements.name: Terminal maintenance — replacement cost over the derived 16.70-year life, or over the 22.97-year second reading of the same notes
judgements.alternative: the other framing, computed and published beside it
judgements.why: the gross-cost-over-charge route validates against the 10.1-year lease term note 7 discloses directly; the accumulated-depreciation route does not

judgements.name: Beta — the own-stock Dimson-corrected regression, or a sector-implied 0.80 prior
judgements.alternative: the other framing, computed and published beside it
judgements.why: SIGCM takes the own-stock regression wherever it clears the usability gate; the prior is priced, not adopted

judgements.name: Terminal real growth — zero, stated, and charged for the capital it would consume, or the +0.49% real the retired typed 2.5% nominal implied
judgements.alternative: the other framing, computed and published beside it
judgements.why: a real rate nobody has quantified is written down as zero rather than left as the residue of typing a nominal

note: every judgement worth more than 5% of the central, both framings computed on the same model and never averaged into one number
